source_metadata.quarantine_reason: WAVE I QUARANTINE (2026-08-27, cold-start red-team finding F2/C1). The cited source 10.1007/s10068-022-01194-w (Food Sci. Biotechnol.) describes an experiment this file does not describe: the paper reacts protein hydrolysates with GLUCOSE and FRUCTOSE at pH 7.5 for 90 min, and reports only RELATIVE GC-MS PEAK AREAS (no absolute concentrations, no internal standard quantitation). This file claims D-XYLOSE + L-cysteine at pH 6.0 for 30 min and carries ABSOLUTE ppb values with per-analyte uncertainty_pct. The paper never mentions 2-furfurylthiol (FFT) or 2-methyl-3-furanthiol (MFT) at all. There is therefore NO POSSIBLE SOURCE for the conc_ppb values below -- they cannot have been read, converted or estimated from the cited paper. This is the citation sweep's identity-not-content blind spot: the DOI is live and the metadata matched, so the anchor passed every previous check, but the paper's CONTENT was never compared against the file's claims.
source_metadata.downstream_consequence: These two files were fit targets for the _HYDROLYSATE_SULFUR_OBSERVABILITY_PROFILES base factors (results/validation/hydrolysate_observability_rederivation.*, Wave H Part 1c) and were scored rows in the literature-coverage headline. The Methional base_factor fitted to them has been REVERTED (0.05623 -> 0.0045) and the re-derivation record RETRACTED. See data/benchmarks/quarantined/README.md.
